_meta.legal_basis: Indian Contract Act 1872 + Industrial Employment (Standing Orders) Act 1946 + Code on Wages 2019 + state Shops & Establishments Acts
_meta.notes: Standard employment contract for white-collar staff. S.27 Contract Act voids post-employment non-compete (Niranjan Shankar Golikari v. Century Spinning AIR 1967 SC 1098; Superintendence Co. v. Krishan Murgai AIR 1980 SC 1717). Confidentiality and IP assignment remain enforceable post-employment. Garden leave permissible. State Shops Acts apply for working hours/leave.

title: Employment Agreement

confidentiality_term.default: Survives termination indefinitely for trade secrets

mandatory_clauses.title: Date of Joining and Place of Work
Probation and Confirmation
mandatory_clauses.content: The Employee shall be on probation for {{probation_months}} months from the date of joining, extendable at the Company's discretion. Confirmation is by written communication.

mandatory_clauses.title: Working Hours and Leave
mandatory_clauses.note: Per applicable Shops & Establishments Act of state

mandatory_clauses.title: Confidentiality and Trade Secrets
mandatory_clauses.content: The Employee shall not, during the term of employment or thereafter, disclose or use any Confidential Information of the Company except in performance of duties. Confidentiality obligations survive termination.

mandatory_clauses.title: Intellectual Property Assignment
mandatory_clauses.content: All IP created by the Employee during the course of employment or using Company resources, relating to the business of the Company, shall vest absolutely in the Company. The Employee assigns all such IP including future IP.

mandatory_clauses.title: Non-Solicitation
mandatory_clauses.content: For a period of {{non_solicit_term_months}} months post-cessation, the Employee shall not solicit employees, customers, or vendors of the Company. Non-solicit is enforceable as it protects Company's legitimate interest.

mandatory_clauses.title: Non-Compete During Employment
mandatory_clauses.note: Post-employment non-compete on employees is VOID under S.27 Contract Act per Superintendence Co. v. Krishan Murgai. Do NOT include post-termination non-compete restraint.

mandatory_clauses.title: Consequences of Termination
mandatory_clauses.content: Return of Company property, settlement of dues, deletion of Company data, exit formalities.

mandatory_clauses.title: Prevention of Sexual Harassment (POSH)
mandatory_clauses.statutory_basis: Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace Act 2013

mandatory_clauses.title: Data Privacy and DPDP Act Consent

prompt_context.system_role: You are drafting an Indian employment contract. Comply with S.27 Contract Act - NO post-employment non-compete. Confidentiality, non-solicit, and IP assignment are enforceable post-termination. Apply Shops & Establishments Act of relevant state for hours/leave/holidays.
drafting_rules: Do NOT include post-employment non-compete (void per S.27 - cite Niranjan Shankar Golikari and Superintendence Co. v. Krishan Murgai).
Non-solicit (employees, customers) for 12-24 months post-termination - reasonable, enforceable as protecting legitimate interest.
IP assignment - express, broad, covers during-employment IP.
Salary breakdown: basic, HRA, allowances. PF (employer 12% on Basic+DA), ESI (if <= 21k gross), PT (state-wise), TDS.
Notice period: 30-90 days typical. Probation usually shorter notice.
Leave per state Shops Act + Factories Act. Typically 12-21 days EL + sick + casual.
DPDP Act consent for personal data processing.
Termination for cause: misconduct, fraud, breach. Termination otherwise: notice period.
Stamp on appropriate value paper (state-wise, usually INR 100-500).

relevantActs.act: Employees' Provident Funds and Misc Provisions Act 1952
Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act 2013

filing_checklist: Execute in duplicate on stamp paper of state-applicable value.
Background verification + reference check before issuance (with consent).
Register with PF/ESI within prescribed period.
Issue appointment letter and joining kit.
Maintain personnel file with KYC, education proofs, prior employment letters.
Onboarding induction including POSH and Code of Conduct.

validation_rules.check: No clause restricting employment elsewhere post-termination
Same notice both ways (or buyout option)
